pulse: log(current month sales / average of preceding six completed months)
contemporaneous_endogeneity: Current sales and price can be jointly determined; coefficient is not a causal effect.
forecast: Market held at first lagged value; expected future pulse zero. Lagged-pulse model uses known prior-month pulse at first step. Actual future CPI. No future event increments.
realized_sales: Diagnostic only: future observed sales pulse supplied; not an operational forecast.
events: Policy groups removed only in data_only/no_market variants; February/April 2025 data-anomaly group retained. Cumulative pulse uses the same persistent-level-shift treatment as cumulative event dummies.
validation: Matching expanding windows; revised data and retrospective event calendar; overlapping annual horizons, no clean annual event-free windows.
